summary: Completed comprehensive testing of CP67 Consumer App Phase 1 features. All 32 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed - verified 8 new pages/components: Home with hamburger menu, Side Drawer with 6 menu items, Enhanced Wallet with points breakdown and tier progress, Transactions with filters, Bill History with status filters, Rewards catalog grouped by store, Help & Support with 4 contact cards and 6 FAQs, Legal with Terms & Privacy, Enhanced Profile with DOB/Gender/Address fields.
passed_tests: GET /api/consumer/wallet/detailed returns 200 with balance, total_earned, total_redeemed, expired, tier info
GET /api/consumer/transactions returns 200 with filter support (all, earn, redeem)
GET /api/consumer/rewards returns 200 with auto-seeded rewards catalog
GET /api/consumer/rewards/history returns 200 with redemption history
GET /api/consumer/bills returns 200 with bill history
Profile has gender, dob, address fields and update works
Program landing page (/app/program) loads without auth
All protected endpoints require auth (401 without token)
Home page loads with hamburger menu button (data-testid='menu-btn')
Side drawer opens with 6 menu items: My Profile, My Rewards, Transactions, Bill History, Help & Support, Legal
Side drawer has working Logout button
Wallet page shows points breakdown: Total Earned, Redeemed, Expired
Wallet page shows tier progress bar with percentage
Wallet page has Scan Bill and Rewards action buttons
Wallet page has View All Transactions and Bill History links
Transactions page loads with filter tabs: All, Earned, Redeemed
Bill History page loads with status filter tabs: All, Approved, Pending, Rejected
Rewards page shows catalog with reward cards grouped by store (Starbucks, H&M, etc.)
Rewards page shows Available Points balance bar
Rewards page has Catalog and Redeemed tabs
Help & Support page shows 4 contact cards (email, phone, support desk, WhatsApp)
Help page shows 6 FAQ items that expand on click
Legal page shows Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy sections
Profile page shows DOB, Gender, Address fields
Profile page has Edit Profile button with edit form
Profile edit form has Gender dropdown and DOB date picker
Logout from side drawer works - clears token and redirects to login
critical_code_review_comments: All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
Auth token properly managed in localStorage
Rewards auto-seeding works correctly from brands collection
Points breakdown calculation (earned - balance - redeemed = expired) is correct
seed_data_creation: Rewards auto-seeded from brands collection (Starbucks, H&M, etc. with Rs 100/250/500/1000 denominations)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 features fully tested and working. All 8 new pages verified: Home (hamburger menu), Side Drawer (6 items + logout), Wallet (breakdown, tier progress, actions), Transactions (filters), Bill History (status filters), Rewards (catalog grouped by store, redemption), Help & Support (4 contacts, 6 FAQs), Legal (Terms & Privacy), Profile (DOB, gender, address, edit form). Backend APIs all return correct data structures. Rewards are auto-seeded from brands if empty.
